subject: general
question: The marked price of an article is Rs. 7,200. Two successive discounts of 9% and 15% are offered. Find the selling price of the article.
solution:
**Given:**

The marked price of an article is Rs. 7,200.

Two successive discounts of 9% and 15% are offered.

**Calculations:**

Effective discount

⇒ 9 + 15 - 15 × 9/100

⇒ 24 - 1.35

⇒ 22.65%

Selling price

⇒ (100 - 22.65)% of 72,00

⇒ 77.35 % × 72,00

⇒ 77.35 × 72

⇒ Rs.5569.20

**Hence, The Required value is Rs.5569.20.**
